[RTCT.6.7] **Compact node-cap encoding.** The per-node token
capacities of [RTCT.6.2] MAY be carried in a compact encoding
in place of the legacy `nodes` list (field 8). This is a pure
wire-size optimization gated on the `realtime` capability —
the `RealtimeContract` atom is `realtime`-only ([RTCT.6.3]) — and the logical
contract and its `rt_config_sha256` ([RBND.4b]) are identical to
the uncompacted encoding ([RBND.4b.8]).
